guideAppBarSubtitle: Practical tips & bookkeeping flow for small businesses
guideHeroHeadline:
Master Shop Bookkeeping
in 4 Easy Steps
guideHeroDescription: Catat Untung is designed so you can record sales in just 1 minute every day without the hassle of paper ledgers.
guideStep1Description: Add the products you sell along with their selling price and unit cost of goods (HPP). If you do not know your HPP yet, use the HPP Calculator feature.
guideStep2Description: Every evening or when the shop closes, open the Sales Recap menu. Enter the number of product units sold today.
guideStep3Description: See directly on the Home page how much money came in (revenue), how much capital was used, and the net profit you take home.
guideStep4Description: Learn which products sell best (Best Seller) and the weekly revenue trend. You can also export monthly reports to PDF / CSV format.
guideTip1Description: Avoid using sales cash for personal spending before calculating monthly net profit so your business capital is not eroded.
guideTip2Description: Many traders forget to count the cost of plastic bags, cups, and LPG gas in the HPP, so the profit margin ends up smaller than expected.
guideTip3Description: Because this app is 100% offline, back up your data in Settings > Backup every weekend to keep your transaction history safe.
guideFaq1Answer: Not at all. Catat Untung runs 100% offline. Data is stored in your smartphone internal storage so you can record anywhere without internet quota.
guideFaq2Question: How do I move data when I change smartphones?
guideFaq2Answer: Open Settings > Backup & Restore. Choose "Create New Backup", save the backup file to Google Drive or send it to your WhatsApp. On the new smartphone, install the app and choose "Restore Data".
guideFaq3Question: What if I give a product away for free / as a tester?
guideFaq3Answer: You can still record its capital in the daily recap, or add a product with a selling price of Rp 0 so the capital still counts in your net profit bookkeeping.
guideFaq4Question: How do I print a report as a business owner?
guideFaq4Answer: Use the Settings > Export Report menu. You can pick a specific date range and download a neat print-ready PDF report or CSV format for processing in Microsoft Excel.
